title: 第一章 台城劫起第二章 辣水阻道
lines: 寰宇初开，天圆地方。
至清之气上浮，孕育五大神明：元始天尊、太上老君、通天教主、女娲、鸿钧。女娲持土造人，炼石补天；鸿钧衍化生机，泽被万物，令神兽与人和睦共存。
至浊之气下沉，滋长三大心魔：元始心魔、太上心魔、通天心魔。心魔无形，唯恐天下不乱，遂共择一野心枭雄，赋其无边暗力，立为魔盟主，代行毁灭之道。
这一日，平衡倾覆。正南台城永恒赤红的天空，被无端撕裂。浓稠如墨的紫黑云气（蔽天幔帐）自裂缝狂涌而出，瞬间吞没天光。云中传来非人嘶吼，无数扭曲黑影盘旋而下——是魔盟主的魔兽先锋军。
城郊山丘上，两个小小的身影被这末日景象惊得呆立。哥哥台焕（九岁）下意识地护住妹妹台灵（八岁）。他们本是瞒着父亲出来，却目睹了家园被黑暗吞噬的开始。
“哥……城里！”台灵声音发抖。台城方向火光四起，道道祥瑞光芒正被紫黑色迅速污染。
最令人心悸的景象发生在城池上空。一个巍峨的玄黑身影（魔盟主）脚踏魔云，其臂膀上匍伏着一头形貌混沌、散发不祥紫气的魔兽帝江。只听魔盟主举臂向天，声如金铁摩擦：
“魔兵兽帝江，变身！魔兵——江魄！”
魔兽帝江化作深紫邪光冲天而起，当空凝成一柄造型狰狞、缠绕紫黑雾气的奇形大刀——魔兵江魄。
魔盟主执刀，朝台城凌空一挥！
一片甜腻致命的粉紫色迷香雾无声弥漫全城。雾气所及，无论神禽灵兽，尽皆眼神涣散，额现魔纹，哀嚎后转为暴戾嘶吼，周身祥瑞转为污浊紫黑——尽数魔化！神兽化为魔兽，神兵兽则沦为魔兵兽。
“父亲！”台焕失声道。他们看到城主府方向，父亲台振岳那熟悉的刚猛气劲正在爆发，与数道魔焰冲撞。台城并无守护神兽，父亲是以凡人之躯，独抗黑暗。
就在这时，一道白影从城**来，是台灵的伙伴玉兔龙。它口中小心翼翼衔着一枚散发柔和金光的巨蛋——台焕的神兽蛋。蛋壳上，“道”字纹路急促闪烁。
玉兔龙将蛋放入台焕怀中，用爪子在地上急划：“主令：收复中央四大区域。速离！”
“父亲……”台灵眼泪涌出。台焕抱紧温热的神兽蛋，这枚蛋因其纯粹未孵，竟完全未被江魄迷香雾影响。
“走！”台焕拉起妹妹，跟着玉兔龙向荒野深处奔去。身后家园的烽火，是童年戛然而止的休止符。
不知跑了多久，两人力竭瘫坐溪边。怀中的蛋剧烈震动，金光愈盛。
“咔嚓！”
蛋壳破裂，一头身披金鳞、瞳如琥珀的道晶兽轻盈跃出，亲昵蹭蹭台焕，又警惕望向对岸乱石堆，额前“道”字微光流转——神兵兽，道晶兽。
怪叫骤起，乱石后猛地扑出一只双目赤红、獠牙滴涎的巨型魔兽天蝠。一个穿暗红皮甲、持锯齿弯刀的男子（罗正）站在其阴影下，咧嘴笑道：“魔盟主大人正需要新鲜的神兵兽血脉！”
“灵儿退后！”台焕护住妹妹，直面强敌。胸腔中勇气与责任感奔涌，他朗声宣告：
“道晶兽变身，公道的力量，变身道晶！”
道晶兽清越应和，化作金光缠绕台焕右臂，凝成一柄长剑！剑身似玄冰凝铸，晶莹剔透，寒意凛冽，剑格处“道”字光华流转——神兵道晶！澎湃的冰属性力量涌入体内。
“魔兽天蝠，音爆！”罗正挥刀下令。
魔兽天蝠张口，扭曲音波轰然炸开，直袭而来。
content_en:
;;
When the world first opened, the sky was round and the earth was round.
The pure Qi rises and gives birth to the five great gods: Yuanshi Tianzun, Taishang Laojun, Tongtian Cult Leader, Nuwa, and Hongjun. Nuwa used earth to create humans and refined stones to mend the sky; Hongjun generated vitality and nourished all things, allowing mythical beasts and humans to coexist harmoniously.
The extremely turbid Qi sinks and breeds the three major inner demons: the original inner demon, the supreme inner demon, and the supreme inner demon. The inner demon is invisible, and they are afraid that the world will not be in chaos, so they jointly choose an ambitious hero, endow him with boundless secret power, and establish him as the leader of the demon alliance to carry out the path of destruction.
On this day, the balance was overturned. The eternal red sky in Taicheng due south was torn apart for no reason. Purple-black clouds as thick as ink (covering the sky) surged out from the cracks and swallowed up the skylight instantly. An inhuman roar came from the clouds, and countless twisted black shadows circled down - they were the demon beast vanguard army of the Demon Alliance Leader.
On the hills on the outskirts of the city, two small figures stood stunned by this doomsday scene. Brother Tai Huan (9 years old) subconsciously protects his younger sister Tai Ling (8 years old). They came out without telling their father, but they witnessed the beginning of their home being swallowed up by darkness.
"Brother... in the city!" Tai Ling's voice trembled. Fires were everywhere in the direction of Taicheng, and the auspicious light was rapidly being polluted by purple and black.
The most heart-stopping scene occurred above the city. A majestic black figure (the leader of the Demon Alliance) stands on the demon cloud, and on its arm lies a chaotic-looking demon beast Emperor Jiang that exudes an ominous purple aura. Just listen to the Demon Alliance Leader raising his arms to the sky, making a sound like gold and iron rubbing against each other:
"Demon Soldier Beast Emperor Jiang, transform! Demon Soldier—Jiang Po!"
The Demonic Beast Emperor Jiang turned into a dark purple evil light and soared into the sky. In the sky, it condensed into a strange-shaped sword with a ferocious shape and wrapped in purple and black mist - Demonic Soldier Jiang Po.
The leader of the Demon Alliance held his sword and swung it towards Taicheng!
A sweet and deadly pink-purple mist filled the city silently. Wherever the mist touches, no matter the divine birds or beasts, their eyes are distracted, demonic patterns appear on their foreheads, their wails turn into violent roars, and their auspiciousness turns into filthy purple and black - all of them are demonized! The divine beast turned into a demonic beast, and the divine weapon beast became a demonic weapon beast.
"Father!" Tai Huan lost his voice. They saw in the direction of the City Lord's Mansion, their father Tai Zhenyue's familiar fierce energy was erupting, colliding with several demonic flames. There is no guardian beast in Taicheng, and my father is a mortal who fights against the darkness alone.
At this moment, a white shadow came from the city. It was Tai Ling's partner Jade Rabbit Dragon. It carefully held in its mouth a giant egg that emitted a soft golden light - Tai Huan's mythical beast egg. On the eggshell, the lines of the word "道" flashed rapidly.
The Jade Rabbit Dragon put the egg into Tai Huan's arms and scratched the ground with his paws: "Master's order: Recover the four central areas. Leave quickly!"
"Father..." Tai Ling burst into tears. Tai Huan hugged the warm mythical beast egg tightly. Because this egg was purely unhatched, it was completely unaffected by Jiang Po's fragrant mist.
"Let's go!" Tai Huan picked up his sister and followed the Jade Rabbit Dragon towards the depths of the wilderness. The flames of war in the home behind him are the end of childhood.
After running for who knows how long, the two of them collapsed by the stream exhausted. The egg in his arms vibrated violently, and the golden light became stronger and stronger.
"Crack!"
The eggshell cracked, and a Dao crystal beast with golden scales and amber eyes jumped out lightly, rubbed Tai Huan intimately, and looked warily at the pile of rocks on the other side. The word "Dao" shimmered in front of its forehead - the divine weapon beast, the Dao crystal beast.
“Hiss—!”
Strange screams suddenly started, and a giant magical beast Sky Bat with red eyes and drooling fangs suddenly jumped out from behind the rocks. A man (Luo Zheng) wearing dark red leather armor and holding a serrated scimitar stood in its shadow, grinning and said: "The leader of the Demon Alliance is in need of fresh blood of the divine weapon beast!"
"Ling'er, stand back!" Tai Huan protected his sister and faced the powerful enemy. With courage and responsibility rushing through his chest, he declared loudly:
"Transformation of Dao Crystal Beast, the power of justice, transform into Dao Crystal!"
Dao Crystal Beast Qingyue responded, turning into golden light and wrapping around Tai Huan's right arm, condensing into a long sword! The blade of the sword looks like it is made of black ice, crystal clear and freezing cold. The word "Dao" is shining brightly on the sword grid - the divine weapon Dao crystal! Surging ice attribute power poured into the body.
"Warcraft Sky Bat, sonic boom!" Luo Zheng ordered with a wave of his sword.
The Warcraft Sky Bat opened its mouth, and the distorted sound waves exploded, attacking directly.
